product.title: RAUPEX Crosslinked Polyethylene (PEXa) Pipe
product.description: From raw material to finished pipe, under one roof. At our plant in Cullman, Alabama we blend, extrude and test our proprietary formulation to create PEXa pipe. We make sure each foot of pipe that leaves the plant doesn't just meet industry standards, but exceeds them. In order to give you extra piece of mind, every batch of pipe we produce is held until all quality controls tests have been completed to our satisfaction. RAUPEX pipe is built to hold up to a hard day on your job site, not just to pass tests in a laboratory.
features: Better flexibility than other types of PEX
Co-extruded ethylene-vinyl alcohol (EVOH) oxygen diffusion barrier on RAUPEX O2 barrier pipe
Flexible to navigate around crowded mechanical chases during construction
Maintains excellent long-term flow performance by resisting scale
